queue_schema:
CREATE TABLE notification_queue (
		id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
		type TEXT NOT NULL,
		method TEXT,
			status TEXT NOT NULL,
			alerts TEXT NOT NULL,
			operational_links TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
			config TEXT NOT NULL,
		attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		max_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 3,
		last_attempt INTEGER,
		last_error TEXT,
		created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
		next_retry_at INTEGER,
		completed_at INTEGER,
		payload_bytes INTEGER
	)
receipt_schema:
CREATE TABLE notification_delivery_receipts (
		alert_id TEXT NOT NULL,
		alert_start_nanos INTEGER NOT NULL,
		destination_key TEXT NOT NULL,
		delivered_at INTEGER NOT NULL, highest_severity INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, delivered_nanos INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, resolved_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
		PRIMARY KEY (alert_id, alert_start_nanos, destination_key)
	)
